title: The verdict of journalist Ahmad Fauzi
paragraphs: The verdict has been made against the newspaper reporter Borneo Raya, Ahmad Fauzi, as a result: The defendant was sentenced to 8 months in prison.

According to the charges, Ahmad Fauzi published a report about the death of a patient in a local hospital on August 11, 2025, a prosecutor's assessment of false information that caused havoc. The chapter used: section 28 verse (3) ITE Act (fail information).
The Court of Justice Pontinak reads the verdict on February 25th, 2026, a complete copy of the verdict has not been published.
In the matter of Ahmad Fauzi, the law attorney Joseph Maulana says the witnesses filed the defense are not permitted to give a statement.
Ahmad Fauzi worked as a newspaper reporter for Borneo Raya at Pontinak, a journalist's organization assessing that the case could have a lesson in the freedom of the press.
The prosecutor and the defendant can still appeal, Ahmad Fauzi is still being held in custody.
